newsitem.title: UK: Japanese Stocks in London steady, Sony gains.
newsitem.headline: Japanese Stocks in London steady, Sony gains.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London on Thursday were steady to firmer with selective buying in high-tech stocks featuring in an otherwise subdued session, dealers said.
Sony Corporation gained 20 yen from its Tokyo close to finish at 9840 yen in London, as exporters benefitted from the rise of the dollar against the yen.

In London, the Nikkei 50 index rose 4.28 points to 1,589.109 after the Nikkei 225 fell 39.11 points to 20,312.23 as profit taking following Wednesday's more than two per cent gain dragged shares lower.
